Class GlobeCountryLines3D

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.Item3D
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.GlobeCountryLines3D
public class GlobeCountryLines3D extends Item3D
Draws country outlines on a sphere as 3D polyline strips.

Input polygons are provided as rings of Point2D.Double values where:

  • x is longitude in radians (typically wrapped to [-pi, pi))
  • y is latitude in radians ([-pi/2, pi/2])
This is the format produced by edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.GeoJsonCountryLoader.

Dateline seam handling

GeoJSON rings that cross the dateline can contain adjacent points whose longitudes differ by nearly 2*pi. If rendered as a continuous strip on the sphere, those segments would "cut across" the globe.

For demo purposes, this item takes a simple, robust approach: it splits the polyline whenever a segment exhibits |dLon| > pi. This avoids globe-spanning chords at the cost of a small seam gap at the dateline.

Rendering details

By default, vertices are placed slightly above the sphere surface (getRadialLift()) to reduce z-fighting with the sphere mesh.
